subject: Scale size from number of observations

messages.author: 31c1235796669f0b
messages.subject: Scale size from number of observations
parts:
How can I scale dots using number of observations ?
e.g. :

qplot(am, vs, data=mtcars)

gives something like
| + +
|
|
| + +
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
But each dot is hiding many more. Is it possible to use what is under
the dot to size it.
It would give something like that (numbers are dot size)
| 7 7
|
|
| 12 6
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Cheers,
Etienne
